newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts chip equipment cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts chip equipment cos.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said analyst Erika Klauer downgraded three semiconductor equipment companies to hold from strong buy.
-- Downgraded companies include Applied Materials Inc, Novellus Systems Inc and Lam Research Corp.
-- Cited valuation concerns, noting all three were within striking distance or at the firm's target prices.
-- Also cited slowing order momentum, seasonal slowness and softening of DRAM prices.

-- Estimates unchanged. Applied Materials earnings estimates remain $2.50 per share for fiscal 1997 and $3.90 for fiscal 1998. Lam earnings estimates remain $0.57 per share for fiscal 1997 and $0.90 for fiscal 1998. Novellus estimates remain $4.50 per share for fiscal 1997 and $5.75 for 1998.
-- Applied Materials rose 1/2 to 62-1/2, Lam eased 1/8 to 35-1/4 and Novellus shed 3/4 to 76-1/2.
